title: Who was the Most Valuable and Needed NBA Player in the 25-26 season?
text:
Code
library(tidyverse)
library(hoopR)
library(ggrepel)
library(gt)

impact <- load_nba_player_impact(
  seasons = c(2025,2026)
) |> 
  mutate(playerseason = paste(player_name, season))

playerimpact <- impact |>
  filter(min >= 1300 & gp >= 65 & bpm >= 5 & war >= 10 & playerseason > 2025) |> 
  arrange(desc(bpm))

ggplot() + 
  geom_point(data=playerimpact, aes(x=min, y=bpm, color = playerseason)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
  "darkgreen", #Giannis Antetokounmpo
  "red",  #Kawhi Leonard
  "purple",  #Nikola Jokić 2025
  "gold", #Nikola Jokić 
   "pink",  #Shai Gilgeous-Alexander 2025
  "orange",  #Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
  "royalblue",  #Stephen Curry
   "navy"  #Tyrese Maxey
  ) )+
    annotate("rect", fill = "red", alpha = 0.1, 
        xmin = 2550, xmax = Inf,
        ymin = 10, ymax = Inf) +
  geom_text(aes(x=2500, y=10, label="Most Valuable Players"), size=3) +
  labs(
    x="NBA Top Contenders", 
    y="Wins Above Replacement", 
    title="Who in the NBA were the Most Irreplaceable Players?", 
    subtitle="Jokic and Shai were the most key players for their teams for their past seasons.", 
    caption="Source: JR Rhodes-Winfrey"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()  +  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8), 
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size=10), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )











Code
ggplot() + 
  geom_bar(data=playerimpact, aes(x=playerseason, weight=bpm, fill = playerseason))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
  "darkgreen", #Giannis Antetokounmpo
  "red",  #Kawhi Leonard
  "purple",  #Nikola Jokić 2025
  "gold", #Nikola Jokić 
   "pink",  #Shai Gilgeous-Alexander 2025
  "orange",  #Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
  "royalblue",  #Stephen Curry
   "navy"  #Tyrese Maxey
  )) +
  labs(
    x="NBA MVP Canidates", 
    y="Box Plus Minus", 
    title="Which Players had the Most Influence during Games?", 
    subtitle="Our previous top contenders lead the way in these stats too.", 
    caption="Source: JR Rhodes-Winfrey"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()  +  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8), 
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size=10), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
    ) +
  coord_flip()











Code
Athletes <- c("Nikola Jokić", "Nikola Jokić 2025", "Shai Gilgeous-Alexander ", "Shai Gilgeous-Alexander 2025", "Giannis Antetokounmpo   ", "Stephen Curry", "Kawhi Leonard", "Tyrese Maxey")

impact|>  
filter(player_name %in% Athletes) |>
  select(player_name, season, rapm) |>
  arrange(desc(rapm)) |> 
  gt() |> 
  cols_label(
    rapm = "regularized adjusted plus minus") |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Which Athletes Leaves their Team Stranded when Off the Court?",
    subtitle = "Number 15 dominates another column."
  ) |> tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "black", weight = "bold", align = "left"),
    locations = cells_title("title")
  ) |> tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "black", align = "left"),
    locations = cells_title("subtitle")
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("By: JR Rhodes-Winfrey")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
     locations = cells_column_labels(columns = everything()),
     style = list(
       cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = px(3)),
       cell_text(weight = "bold", size=12)
     )
   ) |>
  opt_row_striping() |> 
  opt_table_lines("none") |> 
   data_color(
    columns = rapm,
    method = "numeric",
    palette = c("red", "green"),
    domain = c(0, 6.5)
  )
